summary: Town Board approved a 12-month moratorium on data center projects at a public hearing while it drafts local laws on data center regulation, site permits and design; no applications were pending.
notes: Read via a page summary. Article gives adoption on Tuesday 2026-07-14; expiry computed as 12 months. Distinct from upstream's Schroeppel solar moratorium (Local Law 1 of 2026), which is a different sector.

summary: Commissioners voted 6-0 on 2026-09-24 to adopt a one-year moratorium on large-scale data centers (50 MW+ anticipated peak load), replacing the July interim intake freeze; ends sooner if permanent rules pass.
notes: Upstream row dates the instrument 2026-07-07 (interim freeze) and leaves expiry blank. CBS12 (read) gives final vote Thursday 2026-09-24, 6-0, expiry one year after it takes effect. WLRN (read) confirms 2026-08-27 first reading 7-0. Exact effective date not found; 2027-09 is approximate.

summary: Commission voted unanimously on 2026-01-13 for a moratorium on data center development in unincorporated areas running through 2028; the commission may rescind or extend it at any time.
notes: Upstream row has no date_expires. Fox Kansas (read) says 'through 2028' without a day; search summary said 'end of 2028'. Using 2028-12.
